title: TensorFlowInstallations
description:
This defines the top-level object that describes the data returned by the server.
It contains information about each installation of TensorFlow that is known.

installations.description:
The array of information about Posit Connect's TensorFlow
installations.

TensorFlowInstallation.description: This defines the information provided by the server about a single installation of TensorFlow.

version.description: The version number of this TensorFlow installation.

cluster_name.description:
The cluster that contains this TensorFlow installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the TensorFlow installation is local to
the Posit Connect server.

image_name.description:
The image that contains this TensorFlow installation.
A value of `Local` indicates that the TensorFlow installation is local to
the Posit Connect server.
